question: How much railway is built each year using thermite welds?
answer: Thermite welds join the ends of rail by pouring liquid steel into the gap between them. About 2 million of these welds are made each year. Each one fills a gap of about 2.5 cm, which adds up to roughly 50 km of new track annually.
move: 2 million welds × 2.5 cm ≈ 50 km of rail born liquid each year.
